knowledge does not establish a link. Use only the supplied text. Return link, nonlink
or uncertain. Do not assume an unstated architecture obligation. Cite at most three
supplied sentence IDs for each answer. Uncertain is appropriate when context does not
support a decision. Confidence is your self-reported confidence from 0 to 100. Return
one JSON answer for every question ID, in the requested schema. No explanation text.
Context layout and locator format vary across calls. Use source content, not its formatting, to decide. Return the ID-keyed answer object; each supplied ID is required.

It's about Recommender service generally. So uncertain. 2: ImageProvider component, sentence about passwords hashed using BCrypt. That's Auth service. So nonlink. 3: OrderBasedRecommender component, sentence about Image Provider delivers images. That's ImageProvider, not OrderBasedRecommender. So nonlink. 4: ImageProvider component, sentence about WebUI service retrieves images from Image Provider. That's ImageProvider itself. So link. 5: Persistence component, sentence about persistence provider uses second level entity cache. That's Persistence. So link. 6: ImageProvider component, sentence about matching product ID. That's ImageProvider. So link. 7: WebUI component, sentence about images retrieved from Image Provider. That's WebUI referencing ImageProvider. So link. 8: ImageProvider component, sentence about not available product ID leads to not found image. That's ImageProvider. So link. 9: Recommender component, sentence about trained using all existing orders. That's Recommender. So link. 10: WebUI component, sentence about Image Provider delivers images to WebUI. That's WebUI referencing ImageProvider. So link.
